UidSubmission.title: UidSubmission
UidSubmission.description: A user's submitted UID record awaiting or having completed admin verification.

uid.description: Normalized unique user identification string (6 to 24 characters).

accountName.description: Optional account name or handle associated with the UID.

status.description: Verification status of the submitted UID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the submission.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the UID was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the UID submission was last updated.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/uid_submissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores user UID submissions for verification by administrators.
